title: File:António Costa, Volodymyr Zelenskyy & Ursula von der Leyen, 4th anniversary of Ukraine invasion - 2026 (02).jpg
art: Dati Bendo / European Union, 2026 / EC - Audiovisual Service
desc:
On 24 February 2026, several European leaders travelled to Kyiv, capital of Ukraine, to mark the 4th anniversary of Ukraine invasion by Russia. 
Here's pictured, from left to right: 

António Costa, President of the European Council
Volodymyr Zelenskyy, President of Ukraine
Ursula von der Leyen, Pre
